$comment: Example QuotaFpc deployment config. Copy, rename, and fill for YOUR app. Addresses support env: indirection so configs never hardcode secrets or per-network addresses. See the README's threat-model section before choosing values — especially: allowlist ONLY contracts whose ENTIRE callable surface you are willing to pay for (never a token), and size maxFeeWei from MEASURED action costs times headroom, not from the do-nothing harness floor.
name: example-local
description: Example: sponsors one test contract on a local network.

policy.$comment: maxFeeWei: per-transaction ceiling. Measure your real actions first (measureSponsoredFee); a ceiling below the client fee floor silently stops ALL sponsorship.

allowedAccountClasses.$comment: Compute from YOUR installed @aztec/accounts (the deploy tooling recomputes and refuses a mismatch). Only initializerless account classes are compatible with requireUnpublishedAccounts.
allowedAccountClasses.name: SchnorrInitializerlessAccount
